testName: Data Cloud Identity Resolution Rules & Unified Individual 360 Calculation
steps:
1. In Data Cloud, open Identity Resolution Rulesets
2. Verify Rule 1: "Normalized Email Exact Match AND First Name Fuzzy Match"
3. Ingest two disparate records with Email "alex.turner@cloudcorp.example" (One from CRM, One from WebStore)
4. Trigger Ruleset execution job
5. Navigate to Unified Individuals tab and query for "alex.turner@cloudcorp.example"
6. Verify single Unified Individual record is produced
7. Open Unified Link related list and verify both source system IDs are linked under unified master
